dashboard.views.create_new_kpi(request: HttpRequest) → JsonResponse[source]

Create a new Kpi object using data from the request. Expects POST requests with KPI data (JSON or form data) and returns the new Kpi details.

dashboard.views.dashboard(request: HttpRequest) → HttpResponse[source]

Render the dashboard page. Retrieves the current month and year, and loads KPI data via a cron job import.

dashboard.views.dashboard_campaigns(request: HttpRequest) → HttpResponse[source]

Simple page for /dashboard/campaigns.

dashboard.views.dashboard_campaigns_classification_counts(request: HttpRequest) → JsonResponse[source]

Return counts for main classifications from ChromaDB.

Returns a JSON object: { ‘SAFE’: int, ‘UNWANTED’: int, ‘DANGEROUS’: int } If ChromaDB is unavailable, zeros are returned.

dashboard.views.dashboard_campaigns_mail_volume(request: HttpRequest) → JsonResponse[source]

Return stacked mail volume for the last 15 days.

Response format: { “dates”: [“YYYY-MM-DD”, …], “non_danger”: [int, …], “dangerous”: [int, …], “campaigns”: [ {“name”: str, “start”: “YYYY-MM-DD”, “end”: “YYYY-MM-DD”}, … ] }

dashboard.views.dashboard_campaigns_pca(request: HttpRequest) → JsonResponse[source]

Compute 2D PCA on all ChromaDB embeddings and return scatter points.

Response format: { “points”: [ {“x”: float, “y”: float, “label”: str}, … ], “explained_variance”: [ pc1_ratio, pc2_ratio ] } Optional query param: ?limit=1500 to subsample points if needed.

dashboard.views.dashboard_change(request: HttpRequest, month: str, year: str) → JsonResponse[source]

Change the dashboard month and year. Returns JSON data with updated scores, mail labels, new users, total reporters, total cases, and stats.

dashboard.views.dashboard_change_scope(request: HttpRequest, month: str, year: str, scope: str) → JsonResponse[source]

Change the scope of the dashboard and retrieve corresponding data. Returns JSON data with updated scores, mail labels, new users, total reporters, total cases, and stats based on the given scope.

dashboard.views.logout_view(request: HttpRequest) → HttpResponse[source]

Log out the user and redirect to the login page. Always redirects (or returns a JSON message) regardless of logout success.

dashboard.views.update_existing_kpi(request: HttpRequest, kpi_id: int) → JsonResponse[source]

Update an existing Kpi object using data from the request. Expects POST requests with updated KPI data and returns the updated details.

dashboard.dash_utils.dashboard.update_all_kpi_stats(kpi, current_month: int, current_year: int) → None[source]

Safely updates all KPI statistics in one atomic transaction.

dashboard.dash_utils.dashboard.update_monthly_cases_summary(kpi, current_month: int, current_year: int) → None[source]

Update the monthly cases summary for a given KPI, for current month and year.

dashboard.dash_utils.dashboard.update_monthly_reporter_stats(kpi, current_month: int, current_year: int) → None[source]

Update the monthly reporter statistics for a given KPI. Creates or updates MonthlyReporterStats.

dashboard.dash_utils.dashboard.update_total_cases_stats(kpi, current_month: int, current_year: int) → None[source]

Update the total cases statistics for a given KPI.

dashboard.dash_utils.utils.dashboard_graph(num_emails: int, month: int, year: int) → List[Tuple[str, int]][source]

Prepare top-reporter data for the dashboard.

Args:

num_emails: Maximum number of top reporters to retrieve. month: Month (1–12) for which stats are fetched. year: Four-digit year for which stats are fetched.

Returns:

A list of (username, total_cases) tuples for the top reporters, excluding the configured SUSPICIOUS_EMAIL.

dashboard.dash_utils.utils.dashboard_graph_scope(num_emails: int, month: str | int, year: str | int, scope: str) → List[Tuple[str, float]][source]

Prepares data for the top reporter graph.

Retrieves top users by score for a given month, year, and scope (group membership), excluding a predefined suspicious email username. Users must belong to ALL specified groups.

Parameters:

  • num_emails – The number of top users to retrieve (must be > 0).

  • month – The month (1-12).

  • year – The year.

  • scope – A string representing group names, separated by ‘ | ‘. If empty or ‘global’ (case-insensitive), no group filter is applied.

Returns:

A list of tuples (username, score).

dashboard.dash_utils.utils.dashboard_mail_scope(rank: int, num_emails: int, month: str | int, year: str | int, scope: str) → str[source]

Returns the username (part before ‘@’ if applicable) for a given rank from the top reporters.

Parameters:

  • rank – The rank (1-based) of the email/username to retrieve.

  • num_emails – The total number of top emails considered.

  • month – The month (1-12).

  • year – The year.

  • scope – Group scope string.

Returns:

Username part of email, or empty string if not found/invalid.

dashboard.dash_utils.utils.dashboard_score_scope(rank: int, num_emails: int, month: str | int, year: str | int, scope: str) → float | int | str[source]

Returns the score for a given rank from the top reporters.

Parameters:

  • rank – The rank (1-based) of the score to retrieve.

  • num_emails – The total number of top emails considered.

  • month – The month (1-12).

  • year – The year.

  • scope – Group scope string.

Returns:

Score, or empty string if not found/invalid (or 0 for numeric consistency).

dashboard.dash_utils.utils.get_case_all_dash(month: str | int, year: str | int) → int[source]

Retrieves the total number of cases for a given month and year. Reads from Kpi.total_cases_stats.total_cases or calculates directly. IT DOES NOT CREATE OR UPDATE DATABASE RECORDS.

Parameters:

  • month – The month (1-12).

  • year – The year.

Returns:

Total number of cases, or 0 if not found/error.

dashboard.dash_utils.utils.get_case_all_dash_scope(scope: str, month: str | int, year: str | int) → int[source]

Returns the total number of cases for users in a given month, year, and scope. Users must belong to ALL specified groups.

Parameters:

  • scope – Group scope string.

  • month – The month (1-12).

  • year – The year.

Returns:

Total number of cases, or 0 on error/no data.

dashboard.dash_utils.utils.get_dashboard_email_prefix(rank: int, num_emails: int, month: int, year: int) → str[source]

Django template tag: return the email prefix (before ‘@’) at the given rank from the dashboard graph.

Usage:

{% load dashboard_tags %} {% get_dashboard_email_prefix rank num_emails month year as prefix %} Email #{{ rank }}: {{ prefix }}

Args:

rank: 1-based rank position (must be >= 1). num_emails: Total number of emails to include in the graph (must be >= 1). month: Month number (1–12). year: Four‑digit year (>= 1).

Returns:

The email prefix at the specified rank, or an empty string if inputs are invalid, the external call fails, or the rank is out of range.

dashboard.dash_utils.utils.get_dashboard_score(rank: int, num_emails: int, month: int, year: int) → str[source]

Django template tag: return the score at the given rank for the dashboard.

Usage:

{% load dashboard_tags %} {% get_dashboard_score rank num_emails month year as score %} Score #{{ rank }}: {{ score }}

Args:

rank: 1-based rank position (must be >= 1). num_emails: Number of emails (must be >= 1). month: Month number (1–12). year: Four‑digit year (>= 1).

Returns:

The score (as string) at the given rank, or an empty string if invalid inputs, out‑of‑range rank, or on error.

dashboard.dash_utils.utils.new_reporters_dash(month: str | int, year: str | int) → int[source]

Returns the number of new reporters for a given month and year.

This filter reads from existing Kpi records and does not create new ones. It expects a Kpi object to have a ‘monthly_reporter_stats’ attribute, which in turn has a ‘new_reporters’ attribute.

Parameters:

  • month (Union[str, int]) – The month (1-12) for which the count is fetched. Can be string or int.

  • year (Union[str, int]) – The year for which the count is fetched. Can be string or int.

Returns:

The number of new reporters, or 0 if data is not available or an error occurs.

Return type:

int

Example usage in Django Template: {{ some_month_variable|new_reporters_dash:some_year_variable }} {{ "5"|new_reporters_dash:2022 }}

dashboard.dash_utils.utils.new_reporters_dash_scope(scope: str, month: str | int, year: str | int) → int[source]

Counts users who joined within a specific month and year AND belong to ALL specified groups.

Parameters:

  • scope – Group scope string. Users must belong to ALL groups.

  • month – The month (1-12).

  • year – The year.

Returns:

Count of new users meeting criteria.

dashboard.dash_utils.utils.total_by_danger_dash(danger: Literal['safe', 'inconclusive', 'suspicious', 'dangerous', 'failure'], month: str | int, year: str | int) → int[source]

Returns the total number of cases based on the danger level for a given month and year.

Parameters: - danger (ALLOWED_DANGER_LEVELS): The danger level of the cases. Possible values are “safe”, “inconclusive”, “suspicious”, “dangerous”, and “failure”. - month (Union[str, int]): The month (1-12) for which the cases are counted. - year (Union[str, int]): The year for which the cases are counted.

Returns: - int: The total number of cases based on the danger level, or 0 if not found or an error occurs.

Example usage in Django Template: {{ “safe”|total_by_danger_dash:5:2022 }} {# Returns the total number of safe cases for May 2022 #}

dashboard.dash_utils.utils.total_by_danger_dash_scope(danger: str, month: str | int, year: str | int, scope: str) → int[source]

Calculates total cases of a specific danger level for a given month, year, and scope. Users must belong to ALL specified groups.

Parameters:

  • danger – The danger level string (e.g., “safe”, “dangerous”).

  • month – The month (1-12).

  • year – The year.

  • scope – Group scope string.

Returns:

Total count for the specified danger level.

dashboard.dash_utils.utils.total_reporters_dash(month: str | int, year: str | int) → int[source]

Returns the total number of unique reporters for a given month and year. This version reads pre-calculated statistics from Kpi.monthly_reporter_stats.total_reporters or calculates it directly from UserCasesMonthlyStats if Kpi path is not viable. IT DOES NOT CREATE OR UPDATE DATABASE RECORDS.

Parameters:

  • month – The month (1-12).

  • year – The year.

Returns:

Total number of reporters, or 0 if not found/error.

dashboard.dash_utils.utils.total_reporters_dash_scope(scope: str, month: str | int, year: str | int) → int[source]

Calculates the total number of unique active reporters for a given month, year, and scope. An active reporter is a user with UserCasesMonthlyStats records for the period, belonging to ALL specified groups.

Parameters:

  • scope – Group scope string. Users must belong to ALL groups.

  • month – The month (1-12).

  • year – The year.

Returns:

Total count of unique reporters.
